q2_gaps: vague/abundant quantity of a MASS noun ('plenty of horse-radish') — CardinalityPhrase is explicitly for counting things (it rides a GroupOf group), and the (Degree <N> quantity <marker>) construction is triggered only by 'too much / too little / enough' with a closed marker set (excessive / insufficient / sufficient), so 'plenty' has no licensed encoding and the parse had to coin the level symbol 'plenty'

resultant-state passive in the simple present ('this sushi is seasoned with X') — the participle rule makes it a verb, but a bare simple present takes no status atom, which the status section defines as generic/habitual/dispositional; there is no marker for 'the resulting state holds now' of a specific referent
notes: Demonstrative 'this sushi' as a typed witness, agentless passive with Patient on the treated object, Instrument for the applied substance, and no genus for the non-compositional 'horse_radish' are all correct. The only stretches are the two uncovered constructions above.
